manifest.name: ASP.NET Core
manifest.workers: .NET thread pool sized by the runtime for 2 vCPUs; Server GC (the ASP.NET Core default)
manifest.database_layer: Entity Framework Core 10.0 with the Npgsql provider, pool of 16 connections, Npgsql automatic preparation (Max Auto Prepare=20)
manifest.logging: none per request (Microsoft.AspNetCore and EF Core command logs at Warning); start-up log at Information

phase2.validation: Route constraint {id:int} (404); DataAnnotations: Minimal API validation (AddValidation) for /worlds and the PUT body, Razor Pages model binding (ModelState) for /form: 400, or the form re-rendered (200)

csrf.mechanism: ASP.NET Core antiforgery (cookie token + __RequestVerificationToken field, Data Protection), validated by Razor Pages

session.mechanism: Cookie authentication (AddCookie, SignInAsync), ticket encrypted with Data Protection
